source_text: In philosophical terms, the procedure exemplifies a paternalistic overreach, where short-term communal benefits are imposed at the expense of long-term personal agency, with surveys indicating that a majority of adult men who experienced infant circumcision would not choose it for their own sons if given the option. [77]
